en-US.description: Browse, download and set 4K, HD and live wallpapers as your desktop background
en-US.longDescription: 4KWALL is a fast wallpaper browser, downloader and auto-changer for Windows. Browse thousands of high-resolution 4K, UHD and HD wallpapers powered by the Wallhaven API, set them as your desktop background in one click, and schedule automatic wallpaper changes.
en-US.name: 4KWALL
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed
- Fewer crashes. 4kWall no longer crashes when a window closes with the
  pointer on its edge, when you leave a page while wallpapers or downloads are
  still loading, or when the app quits in the middle of a download.
- Thumbnails load reliably. When the same thumbnail was asked for twice at
  once, one of the two could fail to load.
- Favorites keep working while the auto changer runs. The favorites list no
  longer fails with "database is locked", and a favorites database that can't
  be read no longer closes the app.
- A clear message when server has trouble, instead of "Expecting value:
  line 1 column 1".
- The auto changer stops once 4kWall is uninstalled. On Flatpak, removing
  the app together with its data while it ran in the background left the
  changer running and failing.

glibc 2.31+ (Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 11+, Fedora 34+, Mint 20+). No installation
needed. On systems without FUSE, run with --appimage-extract-and-run.
